notes.title: Small Update before the Official Release
notes.content:
- More Achievements
- Automatic save in multiplayer (match settings)
- Corrections of some errors

notes.title: New Scoring Method, New Achievements and More...
notes.content:
In this update we brought some new features and functions to the game, along with bug fixes in multiplayer mode.

- A new scoring method has been added: Every time a player wins in multiplayer mode, they will earn between 0.5 to 1 point (depending on the mode) in the Leaderboard.
- New achievements for multiplayer mode have been added.
- New feature added: Players can now choose the color of the block for any level or in multiplayer blocks.
- New feature added: Players can adjust spear settings during a multiplayer match.
- New feature added: Players can change spears, backgrounds, and block colors within the lobby in multiplayer mode.
- All languages that were not yet added to multiplayer mode have been included, as it was previously only available in English.
- Bugs related to sounds in the Who Destroys More mode have been fixed.
- A bug in the lobby where a player's photo turned white when re-entering the same lobby has been fixed.

Following these changes, multiplayer mode is no longer in beta.

notes.title: Who Destroys More - New Multiplayer Mode
notes.content:
Who Destroys More is a new mode where all players play in the same scene, and whoever first reaches the block destruction limit (set by the room creator) wins. Blocks are generated in the scene randomly and usually not too close to each other, with two types of configurations for generating blocks depending on how many players will play the mode.

But that's not all: the room creator can set certain mode configurations to hinder players while they are playing. One of these configurations is wood, which, once enabled, will appear randomly on the map, serving as a shield against block destruction.

We also have death blocks, which appear from time to time (randomly) from the left, right, or even from below. When a player's spear is hit by a death block, the player will have to wait 4 seconds to respawn and continue playing the mode.

notes.title: Best Destroyer mode: Medium difficulty is now available
notes.content:
The medium difficulty of the Best Destroyer mode is now available.
Some bugs related to the mode have been fixed.

notes.title: The Multiplayer has arrived with a new mode
notes.content:
We've decided to bring the multiplayer with a new mode for Destroy Blocks. The new mode is called Best Destroyer, where players are taken to separate scenes, and each player's objective is to destroy the blocks that appear in their phase. The player who destroys the set number of blocks first, as defined by the room owner, wins. 

The mode has 4 difficulties: Easy, Medium, Hard, and Random (which combines the other 3 randomly).

Multiplayer is still in beta because we plan to launch a new mode where all players will participate in the same scene and also at the moment, only the Easy difficulty of Best Destroyer mode is available.

notes.title: Leaderboard (NEW) and More Levels Were Added
notes.content:
See below some things that were added in this version:
- The Steam Leaderboard (NEW): we added a system that checks some player statistics, sums these points and sends this information to the Steam Leaderboard, inside the game we also added the Leaderboard and we intend to add another way to get points, but only in a future update.
- 4 more levels: for now, we have only added 4 new levels but we will continue adding new levels over time and we intend that before the final version, the game will have 60 levels in total.

Plans for the Next Update:
* For the multiplayer mode... We're still thinking about ways to bring it into the game, the answer will come soon. *
* More Levels *

notes.title: New Languages, New Spear Movement and More
notes.content:
Check out the latest news below:

- New Languages (10): Chinese (Simplified), Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Spanish and Russian.
- New Functionality: you can move the spear with mouse clicks, this function can be enabled/disabled.
- New Icons: we changed the skill icons in the levels.
- New Icons: we changed the icons in the spear skins selection tab.
- Coin: new look and a new animation in the levels.
- Background (Blocks): new look.
- The sizes and positions of the shop buttons have been adjusted and the scroll bars removed.
- The size of various buttons and images in the menu and levels have been adjusted.
- The game tutorial has been reworked and now has new information.
- Some bugs that did not affect gameplay have been fixed.

Plans for the Next Update:
* Leaderboard *
* More Levels (We decided to add it in the next update) *
* And more... *

notes.title: Rework on Blocks and Spears Skins, New Functionality and Small Adjustments
notes.content:
As the game transitioned from Android to the computer, we decided to make some changes that will make a difference when it comes to graphics. We are making small modifications over time for a better player experience. What we aim for is a graphic rework of some things, bring new functionalities to the game and new levels before the official release. See below what has been changed in this new update:

- Block skins: The texture size of all blocks has been increased, new details and new animations have been added.
- Spear skins: The texture size of all spears has been increased, new details and new animations have been added.
- New functionality: The buttons of the skills that appear on the level interface (green and orange) can be enabled/disabled by the player because the game already has movement by the keys.
- Minor adjustments: The texture of some buttons has been modified.
- Minor adjustments: The spear movement has been slightly smoothed.
- Minor adjustments: The sound of wood breaking has been slightly modified.

Plans for the next update:
* New icons for spears *
* New languages *
* A new type of movement for the spear, which can be enabled/disabled *

Thank you all!
